name: Stoner / Sludge
description: Slow, monolithic riff-rock arc: loom, drag, dissolve, crush.

defaults.concept: Fuzz-saturated stoner rock — down-tuned monolithic riffs, drums dragging behind the beat, a psychedelic void in the middle, ending on a hard stop.

slots.label: Fuzz-Saturated Intro
slots.purpose: FEEL: Looming and ancient. TRICK: Introduce a singular down-tuned guitar riff. Let the final measure ring out with raw amp hum and sustain, empty of drum data before the downbeat hits.

slots.label: The Monolithic Pocket
slots.purpose: FEEL: Deliberate, exhausting, dragging significantly behind the back grid line. PRODUCTION NOTE: To fake real room weight, ensure generated MIDI kick and snare notes hit slightly late against the sequencer block.

slots.label: The Psychedelic Void
slots.purpose: FEEL: Hallucinatory and spatial. TRICK: Heavy rhythms cut completely. The drum generation switches to sparse, ringing cymbal edge scrapes and occasional deep floor-tom strikes to let vocal delays bleed over.

slots.label: The Wall of Riffs
slots.purpose: FEEL: Crushing, infinite momentum. TRICK: Discard standard studio fading. Cut all MIDI notes cleanly on beat one of an unresolved root chord, forcing the track to end on a hard stop.
